card.name: Holds/has verbs about people's credentials
card.fires_on: Verbs of having or holding such as holds, had, have, gaining, or the noun holders. They follow a person or group as subject and lead into a degree, title, evidence or shared trait.

modes.label: Holding a degree or title
modes.description: Holds or holders after a person, introducing a degree, post or title.
modes.example: Grappo<< holds>> a BS in mathematics from the US Air

modes.label: Had/given after also or has
modes.description: Had, have or given after a subject, often with also, introducing something possessed or provided.
modes.example: NIAID-funded scientists also<< had>> synthesized a small cyclic molecule that blocks anth
